Smart Cab and Riding System: 
A Smart Cab and Riding System is a technology-based transportation solution designed to make travel safer, faster, and more
convenient for users. The system typically uses a mobile or web application where passengers can easily book a ride, track
the cab in real time using GPS, and view driver details for security. It may also include features like fare estimation, online
payment, ride history, and emergency alerts. On the driver side, it helps manage ride requests, navigation, and earnings
efficiently. By integrating technologies such as cloud computing, databases, and location tracking, this project aims to
improve urban mobility, reduce waiting time, and provide a reliable and user-friendly cab service experience.
Ipl Auction: 
The IPL Auction project is a software-based system that simulates the player auction process of the Indian Premier League. In this
project, different teams participate in bidding for players, each having a fixed budget, just like in the real IPL auction. Users can act
as team owners and place bids on players based on their performance, role, and demand. The system manages player details, bidding
process, team budgets, and final squad selection. It may also include features like real-time bidding, automatic price updates, and
player statistics. This project helps in understanding auction algorithms, database management, and decision-making strategies while
providing an interactive and realistic cricket auction experience.
